meta.description: Portable brand guideline for Designfoli — a web app for UX designers to build and publish portfolio case studies. Use this file to keep visual identity consistent across the website, marketing, and LinkedIn content.
meta.usage: Hand this JSON to a content/design agent. Treat every value here as a hard constraint. Do NOT invent new colors, fonts, or styles outside this file. When a value is missing, derive it harmoniously from the closest token (e.g. tints via opacity, shades within the documented scale).

voice.tone: Speaks to designers as capable professionals. Action-oriented, concise, never corporate or stiff. Sits in the modern design-tool space (think Framer, Notion, Figma).
voice.audience: UX/product designers building portfolios and case studies; design-curious professionals and hiring managers in their network.
do: Lead with a strong, short hook in the first line
Use verbs in CTAs: 'Get Started', 'Learn More', 'Try Now'
Keep sentences tight — remove filler words
Use the arrow glyph → for forward motion in CTAs and links
dont: No emoji in product UI (sparingly acceptable in LinkedIn copy, but never as a crutch)
No hype words or buzzword stacking
No long preambles — get to the point

casing.headlines: Title Case for major headings, e.g. 'Build Better. Faster. Together.'
casing.uiLabels: Sentence case, occasionally Title Case for CTAs

exampleCopy.subtitle: Use this system to create intuitive and beautiful user experiences.
exampleCopy.cardHeadline: Design at the speed of AI
exampleCopy.cardBody: Transform ideas into UI designs for mobile and web applications.

primary.usage: The single brand color. Use for primary CTAs, links, active states, accents, and the gradient. 500 is the canonical primary.

gradient.usage: Hero backgrounds, glows, gradient text, key highlight panels. Violet → purple. Do not introduce other gradients.

dark.note: Dark is the signature look for product/brand hero moments. Deep navy backgrounds with violet accents. Prefer dark for bold, high-impact LinkedIn graphics.

fontFamily.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (free for commercial use)
fontFamily.note: Mona Sans is a free, open-source variable font. Install it in any tool (Canva, Figma, Google Slides) for exact brand match. No serif or mono in brand materials.

widths.note: Use Expanded Black for big, punchy display headlines on social graphics — it's a distinctive brand move.

rules: Pair a heavy headline (700-900) with a regular (400) body for contrast.

spacing.note: Everything sits on an 8px grid. Section padding 64–96px, card padding 24px.

radius.usage: Cards 12px, inputs/buttons 8px or full pill, badges/tags full pill.

shadows.note: Elevation comes from background-color steps more than heavy shadows. Glow (primary) reserved for CTAs and hero highlights.

iconography.style: Clean, minimal, 1.5–2px stroke, rounded caps — Lucide Icons style
iconography.decorativeMark: ✦ (sparkle/star) used as a brand accent on cards

imagery.photography: None in the core UI system — prefer clean flat surfaces, product mockups, and UI screenshots.
imagery.illustration: None. Use real UI mockups (dashboards, phone frames) as visual interest.
imagery.backgrounds: Solid deep-navy (dark) or clean white/F8FAFC (light). Gradient glow panels for hero moments. No textures or patterns.

linkedin.purpose: Keep LinkedIn content visually consistent with the Designfoli website so the audience recognizes the brand across surfaces.

portraitPost.use: Highest feed real-estate — preferred for single image posts

carouselPDF.use: Document/carousel posts — design each page at this size

hookCard.headline: Mona Sans Expanded Black, white, 64–96px, max 6 words
hookCard.accent: Single primary #5A6BFF underline, dot, or → glyph

carouselPage.background: Alternate #FFFFFF and #F8FAFC pages, or stay dark for a bold set
carouselPage.title: h2 (36px) weight 600

statCard.bigNumber: Display 64px Expanded Black, primary #5A6BFF or gradient text
statCard.label: bodySmall muted below

rules: Always include the ✦ mark or wordmark for brand recall.
One primary color only — #5A6BFF. Use the gradient for emphasis, never random colors.
Mona Sans everywhere. If unavailable in the tool, fall back to Inter or system-ui (closest match).
Keep 64px safe margins so nothing clips in the feed crop.
Dark navy + violet = the signature look. Use it for high-impact posts.
Headlines: max 6–8 words. Let whitespace breathe.
Never stretch the logo, never recolor it outside the palette.

tokensCss.note: For developers — these mirror the website's CSS custom properties so web and social stay in lockstep.
